title: Undefined Behavior
concept: Undefined Behavior (UB) is code the compiler can assume never happens — leading to unpredictable results. XIOM's contracts and type system prevent entire categories of UB.
why: UB is the root cause of the worst bugs: security vulnerabilities, silent data corruption, and 'it works on my machine but crashes in production.'
theory:
## What is Undefined Behavior?

In C, this code has UB:
```c
int x = INT_MAX;
x = x + 1;  // Signed overflow = UNDEFINED BEHAVIOR
```

The compiler can:
- Wrap to INT_MIN
- Crash
- Delete the code entirely
- Make demons fly out of your nose

### UB That XIOM Prevents

| UB Category | C/C++ | XIOM |
|------------|-------|------|
| Null dereference | UB | Trap (via contract) |
| Out-of-bounds access | UB | Trap (debug) / checked |
| Signed overflow | UB | Trap (debug) / wrapping (release) |
| Use-after-free | UB | Compile error (borrow checker) |
| Double free | UB | Compile error (ownership) |
| Data race | UB | Compile error (Send/Sync) |
| Uninitialized memory | UB | Compile error (must initialize) |
| Dangling pointer | UB | Compile error (lifetimes) |

### Contracts Eliminate Remaining UB

```xiom
fn unsafe_index(arr: *Int, idx: Int) -> Int {
  return arr[idx];  // UB if arr is null or idx out of bounds
}

fn safe_index(arr: *Int, len: Int, idx: Int) -> Int
  requires: arr != null;
  requires: idx >= 0;
  requires: idx < len;
{
  return arr[idx];  // Safe — contracts prevent UB
}
```

### The Goal
In pure XIOM (no unsafe blocks), there is NO undefined behavior. UB is confined to unsafe blocks, which you protect with contracts.
tips: In safe XIOM code, UB is impossible — the type system and borrow checker prevent it
In unsafe blocks, YOU are responsible — always add contracts to prevent UB
If a crash is deterministic, it's not UB. UB is when behavior is UNPREDICTABLE
Understanding UB makes you a better programmer in ANY language
common_mistakes: Assuming a crash means UB — crashes are defined behavior (the program terminates)
Writing unsafe blocks without contracts — unsafe without contracts is just C
Believing UB can't happen in your code — it can, especially at FFI boundaries
